principles: Start with site, climate, materials, proportion, daylight and craft before decorative symbolism.
Dome/minaret are optional design languages, not automatic requirements.
Existing-building character may be preserved rather than erased.
Adaptive reuse should reveal honest layers where appropriate: old structure + new qibla intervention.
Prioritize durable, repairable materials over difficult-to-maintain spectacle.
Use local craft and regional architectural language where meaningful, not superficial pastiche.

conversion_modes.description: Keep most existing architecture; mosque identity emerges through orientation, light, prayer floor, signage and selective craft.
Preserve old fabric while adding clearly contemporary mosque elements.
Introduce local Islamic architectural language using regionally appropriate materials/craft.
Major architectural reconstruction where justified by program, condition and approvals.

repair_vs_replace_logic: repair if safe, serviceable, compatible, and lifecycle cost is favorable
replace if safety/compliance, repeated failure, energy/water waste, unavailable parts, or severe deterioration justify it
preserve significant heritage fabric unless conservation strategy supports intervention
